messages:
olivia-ml: quick pulse — where are we on the last wave of open-model intake for the catalog launch? listing out outstanding owners/deps I have so we can close before next monday. TL;DR: need perf sigs, license stamp, and infra quota confirmation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin-bench: OrchID-13B perf profile uploaded to staging yesterday. p50/p95 for our 512-token baseline: 28ms / 210ms (gpu q4_0). still need memory/throughput tests for batch=8. I can run tomorrow AM.

sara-eng: thanks — who owns the batch throughput matrix? devon-product or infra?

devon-product: infra will own the matrix, but product needs the outcomes for the launch checklist. @james-sre can you confirm quota for dedicated pools (staging -> prod)?

james-sre: we have 3x GPUs reserved but autoscale limits block burst >6 GPUs. I can request temporary increase; need ticket from product with expected peak rps and window.

leah-legal: license check on Nightingale-7B is in progress. flagged one clause re: commercial redistribution. can @devon-product confirm intended customer-facing use? if it's internal-only we can probably ship, otherwise we need a short legal addendum.

devon-product: customer-facing chat features planned for launch batch; will need the addendum if Nightingale-7B remains. we can swap to OrchID-13B if legal blocks.

olivia-ml: ok, so owners/next steps: (1) kevin -> finish batch=8 throughput + CSV perf artifacts by 1829530000 (tomorrow EOD) (2) james -> request quota bump after dev posts expected peak numbers (3) leah -> finish license summary + recommended action by 1829510000 (end of day) (4) devon -> confirm whether customer-facing usage is mandatory for Nightingale or if swap acceptable.

kevin-bench: starting tests now. I'll post a tiny perf snippet in thread when done.

catalog-bot: NOTE: model-catalog ingestion job queued (orchid-13b, nightingale-7b). current ingest status: orchid-13b -> pending-verification, nightingale-7b -> license-review.

sara-eng: code review ping for the catalog UI list filter landed: PR #4123. @olivia-ml can you skim? needs product + ML signoff (2 approvals).

olivia-ml: will review in 1 hour. quick note: make sure the model card includes explicit 'fallback model' field so routing can pick OrchID if Nightingale is restricted.

kevin-bench: perf summary (quick): batch=8, seq=512, model=orchid-13b, card: "q4_0", p50=30ms, p95=220ms, tokens/s (single GPU) ~ 420. attaching synthetic load command we used:

```
> ./run_load.sh --model orchid-13b --batch 8 --seq 512 --duration 300
```

devon-product: great, that helps. if throughput meets SLOs we can mark "perf-approved" in the intake checklist. who marks that?

kevin-bench: I'll update the intake ticket with perf-approved + attach logs.

leah-legal: quick legal note — Nightingale license has a restrictive export clause for some countries. filing a short memo and recommended workaround (use OrchID fallback + geo-routing).

james-sre: once dev posts expected transient peak numbers I'll open the quota request; estimate 2-4 hour lead to approve. btw if Nightingale can't be used in certain regions we need routing policy entries — @sara-eng to add flags to the service config?

sara-eng: yep I can add a region deny list in the routing config. will push a small schema change, PR after olivia's signoff on UI.

olivia-ml: sounds like a plan. final ask: everyone update their checklist item in the intake ticket (T-9876) so we have a green status by friday. will convene async if blockers pop up. :white_check_mark:

devon-product: noted — I'll add customer-impact note + rollback plan.

kevin-bench: uploaded artifacts to the ticket (logs + csv) at 1829509000. marked perf-approved.

catalog-bot: UPDATE: intake ticket T-9876 status -> perf-approved by kevin-bench, license-pending by leah-legal, infra-quota-pending by james-sre.

leah-legal: posted license memo and recommended actions at 1829512000. short version: swap to OrchID for EU/APAC or attach addendum for commercial use.

james-sre: quota request filed (RQ-6802) at 1829515000, requested window 2026-06-01 00:00 -> 2026-06-14 23:59 for launch traffic tests.

olivia-ml: excellent. if no objections I'll mark the catalog launch checklist as "on track" for now. thanks everyone — ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
